intent.raw: /goal craft: identify specs that do not necessarily need coding; dispatch-spec: create a subagent strategy; invoke: create define/design/plan development artifacts for each topic; execute the strategy.
intent.objective: Classify Golden Quill Craft nodes whose next useful movement is authoring rather than code mutation, then produce canonical Invoke define/design/plan artifacts for each selected node.
intent.operator_sentence: The result should be canonical artifacts for each of the non-strict coding nodes.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The selected node set can be reviewed or authored in parallel by role, but runtime subagent execution needs operator approval.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The problem shape splits cleanly across governance, procedure/proof, operations, and parent-synthesis lanes. Parallel review would be useful after this local authoring pass, while the current pass can produce the canonical artifacts without spawning agents.
context: Craft sweep discovered 12 ledgers; 10 selected nodes are authoring/spec/procedure surfaces.
tilth-runtime-build and root promotion-governance are excluded because their next useful movement is stricter runtime/build implementation.
Existing BUILD-SPEC.md files are treated as source evidence, not overwritten.

roles.purpose: Author and review governance decision packets and canon guardrails.
Author and review procedure, test, proof, and receipt contracts.
Author and review service, sales, legal, finance, and support operating artifacts.
Check parent recomposition and cross-node gate consistency.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve spawning role-bound subagents to review or extend the non-strict-coding Invoke artifacts in parallel.

steps.name: Craft ledger state sweep

capability_metadata.reason: Craft is installed as a generated-native runtime package in this workspace.

stop_conditions: Every .craft/ledger.yml in the workspace has been discovered before selection.
Selected and excluded nodes are explained with source ledger paths.

steps.name: Non-strict-coding selection synthesis
stop_conditions: The selection rule distinguishes authoring/spec work from strict runtime/code implementation.
No selected node claims runtime completion.

steps.name: Invoke define/design/plan authoring fanout
stop_conditions: Every selected node has a canonical Invoke development artifact.
Each artifact includes a coding boundary and next route.

steps.name: Validate dispatch and artifact boundaries
stop_conditions: Dispatch validator returns pass or named residue.
Artifacts do not claim code/runtime execution, ledger closure, or canonical knowledge promotion.

gates.condition: Every selected node must cite its owning Craft ledger and source BUILD-SPEC.
The route authors planning/spec artifacts only and must not claim code mutation, runtime execution, or ledger closure.
Recommended delegated subagent review remains authorization=requires_user_permission until Josh approves a runtime fanout.
Execution or authoring evidence may update local planning artifacts but cannot automatically promote canonical Arcanum knowledge.
The dispatch JSON validates against the local dispatch-spec validator.

boundaries.contract: Invoke owns define/design/plan authoring; each Craft node retains its own ledger authority and unresolved gaps.
Runtime subagents are recommended only; no delegated execution starts without operator approval.

boundaries.to_owner: Craft status and future task-session routes
boundaries.contract: Artifacts return concrete paths and named residue, not vague completion claims.

authority.lifecycle: invoke owns this authoring pass; each node owns downstream lifecycle.
authority.execution: not executed in this dispatch; future task-session or subagents require approval.
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validator plus reviewable artifact boundary checks.
authority.evidence: local file paths and Craft ledger references.
authority.memory: Craft ledgers remain source of truth; this package is an artifact set.
authority.promotion: no automatic promotion from this dispatch.

stores: selected node development/refinement-runs or future task-session evidence folder

state_namespaces.write_policy: One INVOKE-DEVELOPMENT.md artifact per selected node.
Source of truth; not mutated by this dispatch unless a separate Craft update is performed.

promotion_splits.source: authoring evidence and future runtime receipts
promotion_splits.target: local planning artifacts and Craft ledger evidence
promotion_splits.rule: Evidence may inform local planning state, but canonical knowledge changes require owner review and a separate route.

promotion_guardrails: No output from this route changes canonical Arcanum sigils, spells, inventory, ontology, glossary, or generated runtime packages.
No selected node artifact claims code mutation, runtime execution, child receipt recomposition, or closure of operator-owned decisions.
No org PROJECT_CONTEXT is read or referenced.
